prompt:
Create one new vertical 2:3 finished fantasy-game portrait of the ADULT female archer in the references. The sprite sheet defines identity. The old portrait is visual reference only for crimson ponytail, gold/indigo-violet costume and ivory recurved longbow; its standing pose and busy ornament are not templates.

Design goal: elegant featured heroine, with purposeful moderate richness. Preserve the gold crest and the distinctive gold-and-purple armor dress. Give the clothing a coherent tailored structure: continuous fitted violet torso, shaped gold shoulder armor, one broad decorative gold chest/waist framing motif, articulated gold bracers and greaves, a short structured overlapping battle-skirt with broad attached panels, dark leggings and fitted practical boots. The parts should form one designed outfit, not a plain sleeveless shirt with separate generic guards. Use a single small red jewel as a focal accent and repeat one angular motif on the bow fittings. Leave generous uninterrupted cloth and armor surfaces. Richness comes from shape, cut and layered construction. Keep it fully clothed and action-ready.
No trailing ribbons, long panels, cape, tassels, chains, scattered jewelry, tiny repeated edging or random sharp spikes. Red ponytail gathered in several orderly large locks, moderate length and volume. Cloth has only necessary folds. Gold has controlled bevel highlights, never oily shine.

DNF original-PC awakening illustration direction: energetic mature anime linework, strong silhouette contour, lighter interior line, substantial yet clean painted volume. The archer takes a powerful forward lunge and twists her torso while aiming the drawn bow diagonally off-camera. Believable hands, string and nocked arrow. Full body, readable face, coherent body proportions, strong perspective. Quiet low-detail cool background and warm side light. Motion is in anatomy, stance and composition. No text, logo, UI or card frame.
